welcome: Welcome! Send me a photo of any product and I'll find it on Amazon.
help:
Send me a photo of a product and I'll identify it and find it on Amazon.

You can also send a text message to search by keywords.

Commands:
/start - Start the bot
/lang - Change language
/help - Show this message
err_no_results: No products found. Try a different photo or search term.
err_no_photo: Please send a photo of a product.
err_rate_limit: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
err_analysis_failed: Could not analyze the photo. Please try again with a clearer image.
err_search_failed: Search failed. Please try again later.
err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
